Below is a **clear, Canva-style process + page layout explanation** — focused on **how the page looks** and **how the flow works**, not code.

---

## 🧠 Overall Idea (Canva-like Editor)

The app is a **two-panel editor**:

* **Left Side → Controls / Settings**
* **Right Side → Live Canvas (Image + Text)**

Everything you change on the left updates the canvas instantly on the right.

---

### 🔹 Layout Split (Horizontal)

```
┌─────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────┐
│  LEFT SIDEBAR       │   RIGHT WORKSPACE              │
│  (Controls)         │   (Canvas Preview)             │
│                     │                               │
│  Upload Image       │        ┌───────────────┐      │
│  Add Text           │        │               │      │
│  Font Settings      │        │   CANVAS      │      │
│  Opacity Slider     │        │   (Konva)     │      │
│  Layers (optional)  │        │               │      │
│                     │        └───────────────┘      │
└─────────────────────┴───────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 🧩 LEFT SIDE – Settings Panel (Like Canva)

This panel is **fixed width** and scrollable.

### 1️⃣ Image Section

* Upload image button
* Shows upload progress
* Automatically:

  * Saves original image
  * Starts background removal
* Optional:

  * Reset image
  * Replace image

---

### 2️⃣ Text Section

* Add new text button
* Text list (like layers)
* Select active text

Each text item has:

* Text input
* Font size
* Font weight
* Color picker
* Letter spacing
* Alignment (left / center / right)

---

### 3️⃣ Foreground (Subject) Controls

* Opacity slider (0 → 1)
* Toggle visibility
* Helps fine-tune “behind text” illusion

---

### 4️⃣ (Optional) Layer Manager

* Background
* Text(s)
* Foreground subject
* Reorder text layers only

---

## 🎨 RIGHT SIDE – Canvas Workspace

This is the **visual editor**, powered by **react-konva**.

### What the user sees:

* Centered canvas
* Fixed aspect ratio (Instagram / YouTube / Custom)
* Light checker background (to show transparency)
* Zoom in / zoom out

---

### 🧠 Canvas Layer Order (Critical)

```
TOP
┌─────────────────────────────┐
│ Foreground Image (Subject)  │  ← transparent PNG
│ listening = false           │
└─────────────────────────────┘
┌─────────────────────────────┐
│ Editable Text               │  ← draggable, selectable
└─────────────────────────────┘
┌─────────────────────────────┐
│ Original Image (Background) │
└─────────────────────────────┘
BOTTOM
```

This order **never changes**.

---

## 🖱️ Interaction Flow (Feels Like Canva)

### User Actions → What Happens

**Upload Image**
→ Background image loads
→ Foreground image is generated
→ Canvas updates automatically

**Add Text**
→ Text appears in center
→ User drags it
→ Text visually goes *behind subject*

**Drag Text**
→ Foreground does NOT block interaction
→ Text moves freely

**Adjust Opacity**
→ Subject fades in/out
→ Text visibility improves

---

## 🧠 Why This Feels Like Canva

* Instant visual feedback
* No “apply” buttons
* Everything is draggable
* Sidebar controls affect selected element only
* Canvas is always visible

---

## 📐 Responsive Behavior

### Desktop

* Sidebar left (300–360px)
* Canvas fills remaining space

### Tablet

* Sidebar collapsible
* Canvas centered

### Mobile (Optional)

* Bottom sheet controls
* Canvas on top

---

## 🔄 Full User Flow (End-to-End)

1. User opens editor
2. Uploads image
3. AI removes background
4. User adds text
5. Text appears behind subject
6. User adjusts font & opacity
7. Final design looks “professional”
8. Export image (PNG)

---

## ✨ Mental Model (Simple)

> **Canva UI + Photoshop layering + AI background removal**
